classification_basis: B12 TYPE A has 27/40 MAJOR versus 10/56 NO_MAJOR events, with U_near AUC 0.777679 and higher MAJOR amplitudes. TYPE B is uncommon (3/40 and 2/56), not the dominant event. This is a directional exploratory signal, offset by increased proxy false alerts and severe FULL263 binary saturation. It motivates new-data validation only, not established usability.
